第一步：确认自己在问哪一种福利: Step 1: identify the benefit you are asking about
Social Security 退休福利通常依据缴纳社会保障税的工作记录；401: Social Security retirement benefits generally depend on work covered by Social Security taxes. A 401(k), IRA or employer retirement plan has separate rules. SSI serves people with limited income and resources who are 65 or older or meet disability/blindness conditions, subject to other eligibility rules. Reaching retirement age alone does not establish which benefit you can receive.

第二步：先核对记录，不用朋友的金额作比较: Step 2: check your record rather than comparing friends' payments
SSA 说明，按本人工作记录申请退休福利通常需要 40 个工作积分，每年最多四个: SSA explains that retirement benefits based on your own record generally require 40 work credits, with at most four earned per year. Credits depend on covered earnings; living in the United States for ten years does not automatically earn them. Credits establish part of eligibility, and additional credits alone do not mean a larger monthly payment. Review annual earnings in your account and ask SSA about correction documents if any are missing.
把工作年份、雇主和自雇收入与 SSA 工作记录逐项比对；记录缺漏年份。: Compare work years, employers and self-employment earnings with your SSA record, noting missing years.
分别询问本人退休福利、可能适用的配偶／前配偶或遗属福利；这些路径条件和领取时间不: Ask separately about your own retirement benefit and potential spouse, former-spouse or survivor benefits; eligibility and timing differ.
涉及移民身份、境外工作或长期境外居住计划时，直接请 SSA 核对对应规则。: Ask SSA to review applicable rules for immigration status, work abroad or plans to live abroad for an extended period.
家庭收入或资源较少时，另问 SSI；不把退休福利积分当作 SSI 资格判断。: If household income or resources are limited, ask separately about SSI. Retirement credits do not determine SSI eligibility.
第三步：比较时间，分清领取月份和到账月份: Step 3: compare timing and distinguish the benefit month from the payment month
本人退休福利通常最早可从 62 岁开始，提前于完全退休年龄领取会降低月领金额；延: Retirement benefits on your own record can generally start at 62. Starting before full retirement age reduces the monthly amount; delaying can increase it, generally up to age 70. Full retirement age depends on your birth year and is 67 for people born in 1960 or later. The right month depends on your circumstances; this guide does not choose it for you.
SSA 的时间说明允许最早在希望开始领取的月份前四个月提出申请，首笔支付一般在所: SSA explains that you can apply up to four months before your intended benefit start month. The first payment generally arrives the following month. If you will keep working, ask about annual earnings limits and benefits that may be withheld before full retirement age. Review Medicare enrollment timing separately; delaying retirement benefits does not establish that you can delay Medicare.
在 SSA 计算器按出生年份查日期，再比较本人账号的估算。: Use SSA's calculator to check the date by birth year, then compare your account estimates.
第四步：带着清单联系 SSA，可以要求口译: Step 4: contact SSA with your questions and request an interpreter
SSA 官方提供免费口译，电话与办公室均可使用。可拨打 1-800-772-12: SSA provides free interpreters by phone and at offices. Call 1-800-772-1213 and tell the representative you need a Chinese interpreter. SSA will explain appointment and document requirements for your application. Family members can help organize questions, while you or an authorized person should safeguard accounts and application documents.
